title: Stencil ops: onboarding scrape — notes May 19 2026
content:
Purpose
Quick capture from the Stencil ops session focused on the new model onboarding pass + quantization/eval sanity checks. This doc is a working note — experimental results, odd failures, and concrete next actions.

High-level summary
- Ran onboarding for mosaic-small-v1 (8B) and mosaic-medium-v1 (13B) with two quant configs: static 4-bit PTQ (generic) and mixed int8/4-bit (layerwise) using the new lattice packer.
- Primary metric: perplexity delta on canned eval set (20k tokens) + median P99 token latency at seq=512. Secondary checks: generation coherency (prompt/response spot checks), KV cache memory footprint, and rollout safety rules.
- Outcome: 4-bit static gives ~1.8% perplexity regression on the small model, 3.5% on medium. Mixed int8/4bit reduces regress to ~0.9%/1.7% respectively but increases peak memory by ~6%. Latency for 4-bit improved median token time by ~12% on the small model, but P99 spikes at ~20% in tail for seq512 on shared nodes.

Experiments run (short form)
1) mosaic-small-v1 -- ptq-4bit-static
   - config: lattice-packer v0.3, no KV-prefetch, continuous-batching disabled
   - dataset: eval-std-20k (mix of wiki+conversations), temperature sampling fixed
   - result: ppl +1.8%, median token latency 24ms -> 21ms, P99 78ms -> 94ms
   - note: P99 tail correlates with background GC on node (see infra note below)

2) mosaic-small-v1 -- mixed-int8-4bit
   - config: per-layer scale, use kernel-set alpha-2, KV-prefetch enabled
   - result: ppl +0.9%, median token latency 23ms -> 20ms, P99 78ms -> 82ms
   - memory: working set +6% vs baseline; observable KV cache increase when warm-starting similar prompts

3) mosaic-medium-v1 -- ptq-4bit-static + microbatch=2
   - result: ppl +3.5%, median latency improved 15%, P99 increased 22% on seq512.
   - hypothesis: quantization noise interacts with longer-context attention patterns causing re-computation paths to fire more often.

4) mosaic-medium-v1 -- mixed-int8-4bit + kernel-tuning beta
   - result: ppl +1.7%, latencies similar to baseline at median, P99 reduced vs static 4-bit by ~12% but still above float by ~8%

Operational observations
- KV prefetching is beneficial for mixed configs but needs a bump in prefetch-window heuristics; otherwise we see transient misses that cost ~8-12ms each.
- Node-level GC and NFS metadata spikes aligned with ~10% of P99 outliers. We should instrument the serving nodes to log GC phases with timestamps against request ids for one more run.
- The lattice-packer occasionally produced an unsupported kernel selection for a specific attention head size (head_dim=96) causing fallback to slower path. Patch idea: add a head-dim override mapping for older kernels.

Evaluation notes
- The canned eval set seems to under-emphasize instruction-following style failure modes; a small addendum of 500 instruction prompts (from onboarding prompts pool) amplified regressions in noisy decoding. Plan to add this as eval-lite in the onboarding pipeline.
- Generation coherency: spot checks found hallucinations in 4-bit static where repeated prompts with slight rephrasing diverged; mixed-int8-4bit preserved more stable completions.

Model-onboarding checklist status
- Binary artifacts: OK (packaged by release-engineering/pack-run-20260518)
- Perf benchmarks: preliminary done (this doc), need one more run with GC tracing
- Safety / filters: smoke check passes; add 500 instruction-light prompts to run
- Rollout plan: canary to dedicated pool (10% traffic) with auto-rollback on perplexity/regression alert + latency SLO breach (P99 +15% over baseline)

Open issues / action items
- A1: Infra — enable GC trace logging on 3 canary nodes and re-run mosaic-small-v1 mixed config. Owner: Marcus Lin. Due: 2026-05-24.
- A2: Eval — create eval-lite set of 500 instruction prompts and add to onboarding harness. Owner: Jinsoo Park. Due: 2026-05-21.
- A3: Runtime — add head-dim override map to lattice-packer and add unit coverage for head_dim in kernel selector. Owner: Lila Gomez. Due: 2026-05-26.
- A4: Observability — add KV-prefetch hit/miss counter to per-request trace (low-cardinality metric) and ship to console for next 48h. Owner: Aisha Patel. Due: 2026-05-22.
- A5: Risk assessment — draft canary rollback policy doc fragment for QE reviewers (criteria: ppl delta >1.5% OR P99 latency > +15% baseline). Owner: Product-Safety (requesting volunteer). Due: 2026-05-23.

Decisions made
- Use mixed-int8-4bit as preferred quant profile for mosaic onboarding (balance of quality/latency) unless memory constraints or regulatory constraints disallow it.
- Prefer canary on Dedicated pool for initial rollout to reduce noisy neighbor tail effects.

Notes to self / scribbles
- Try microbatching with microbatch=3 for small model to see if P99 tail smooths (might increase median slightly).
- Check whether our tokenizer padding strategy creates long prefix zeros that affect KV cache warmup.
- Possible follow-up: run adversarial prompt sweep on mixed-int config to surface edge-case hallucinations.

Meeting attachments / references
- Quick perf table (to paste into Confluence)
  model | config | ppl delta | median token ms | p99 token ms | mem delta
  mosaic-small | float | 0% | 24 | 78 | 0%
  mosaic-small | 4bit-static | +1.8% | 21 | 94 | -12%
  mosaic-small | mixed-int8-4bit | +0.9% | 20 | 82 | +6%
  mosaic-medium | float | 0% | 48 | 172 | 0%
  mosaic-medium | 4bit-static | +3.5% | 41 | 210 | -14%
  mosaic-medium | mixed | +1.7% | 43 | 183 | +6%

- Relevant tickets: JIRA-AP-3124 (onboarding run failures), GH #987 (lattice packer fix), CONFLUENCE-APPLIED-ML-ONBOARD-87 (onboarding spec)

Next check-in
- Quick sync Fri 2026-05-21 10:30 (30m) to review GC-logged run and decide canary timing.

Unresolved questions
- Why does static 4-bit regression increase with model size? Noise amplification from attention math or bias folding issue?
- Are we seeing any dataset leakage between eval-std and onboarding prompts that bias perplexity? Need to run a dedup check.

If you want raw logs / perf traces I pushed the run artifacts to gs://redwood-appliedml/onboard/stencil/2026-05-19/ (tagged by run id).

-- Aisha
